name: nanobot
description: Runs a self-hosted personal AI agent from a WebUI, terminal, or chat apps, combining tools, long-term memory, MCP servers, model routing, and scheduled automations.

skills.name: Connect Chat Channels
skills.description: Connects the agent to Telegram, Discord, Slack, WeChat, Feishu, Email, and Mattermost from a single long-running gateway process.

skills.name: Retain Long-Term Memory
skills.description: Keeps session history and long-term memory through Dream so goals, tools, and chat context survive multi-session work.

skills.name: Delegate To Subagents
skills.description: Consults inline subagents without leaving the current task and switches model presets per session directly from the composer.

skills.name: Schedule Agent Automations
skills.description: Runs cron-scheduled automations and long-horizon goals unattended through the gateway, configured from the WebUI Automations panel.

skills.name: Expose OpenAI-Compatible API
skills.description: Serves an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint plus a Python SDK with sessions, events, and hooks for integrating nanobot locally.
